in_hebrew.name: Artamas
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bold, firm, or strong
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Artamas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'artamos' meaning 'strong, firm, or bold'. In Greek mythology, Artemas was an alternative name for Artemis, the goddess of the hunt and wilderness.

in_greek.name: Artamas
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bold, firm, or strong
in_greek.long_meaning: Artamas είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'artamos' meaning 'strong, firm, or bold'. In Greek mythology, Artemas was an alternative name for Artemis, the goddess of the hunt and wilderness.

in_latin.name: Artamas
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bold, firm, or strong
in_latin.long_meaning: Artamas est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'artamos' meaning 'strong, firm, or bold'. In Greek mythology, Artemas was an alternative name for Artemis, the goddess of the hunt and wilderness.
